3532-5078-6769-8346.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6769-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

3968-4050-4078-4210.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-4210.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

822-950-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Fatestitcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-950-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

3099-5137-6723.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-5137-6723.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

618-4247-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4476-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4476-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

586-864-2279-2292-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2279-2292-3125.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

3129-4365-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

862-1778-6108-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.

862-1778-6108-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1394-2060-5686-7038-7741.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Shang-Chi.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Shang-Chi.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1575-4231-7601.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Foods.
654-1575-4231-7601.description:
Activate Insatiable Frugivore by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing at least four Foods.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers for each Food sacrificed.
Resolve a Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Food, Clue and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
When the Food, Clue and Treasure enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers three times, untapping the Food, Clue and Treasure.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Insatiable Frugivore ability from step 1, giving creatures you control at least +4/+0 and menace until end of turn.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Repeat.
654-1575-4231-7601.notes: If you sacrifice five or more Foods each loop, you'll get infinite Clue and Treasure tokens.

3455-4004-7149.description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Vizier of Many Faces into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vizier of Many Faces dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Vizier of Many Faces enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Vizier of Many Faces leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Vizier of Many Faces from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

140-5173-5553-5626.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, causing black and red spells you cast to cost {1} less for each life you've lost this turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-2173-5220-7192.description:
Cast Wild Cantor by paying its mana cost.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2203-2366-5702-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-5702-6968.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

730-1479-2841-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
730-1479-2841-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

30-147-997.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-147-997.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-147-997.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

2034-4929-5224-6967.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cryptic Trilobite, adding {C}{C}.
When Cryptic Trilobite dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2173-4050-5220-6535.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

2173-2921-5220-6539.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

486-4222-6784.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Freed from the Real to become an artifact.
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Steelswarm Operator.
Repeat from step 2.
486-4222-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Steelswarm Operator's first ability instead.

372-4681-6472.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Deceptive Frostkite.
372-4681-6472.description:
Cast Deceptive Frostkite by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Deceptive Frostkite's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Deceptive Frostkite ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Deceptive Frostkite leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Deceptive Frostkite into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Deceptive Frostkite from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

64-1987-4276-4823.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-1987-4276-4823.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Timeless Witness and Warden of the Eye.
When Timeless Witness and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-4276-4823.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

141-972.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-972.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Saheeli's Artistry
141-972.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Saheeli's Artistry, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Saheeli's Artistry, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
141-972.notes: You may choose both of Saheeli's Artistry's modes, if desired.

280-1479-4677.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-4677.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Zendikar's Roil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-2857-5231.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2857-5231.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Thermopod.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Thermopod enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.

2177-3550-3607-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.

Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Selective Memory, exiling all nonland cards from your library.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.

Storm-Kiln Artist and River Kelpie trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the River Kelpie trigger, causing you to draw a land card.
Resolve Flame Jab, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2634-2959-4783.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, targeting Heat Shimmer.
Choose to have Rootha returned to the command zone instead of your hand.
Resolve the Rootha ability, copying Heat Shimmer, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Resolve the copy of Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
Hellkite Courser enters the battlefield, putting Rootha from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hellkite Courser token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1209-1819-3457-3740-4684-5006.description:
Tap Seeker of Skybreak to untap itself.
Mill 1 with Mesmeric Orb.
Repeat until you mill Nullpriest of Oblivion and Syr Konrad shuffling when you do not mill them using the Titan.
Cast and kick Nullpriest of Oblivion with Lurrus of the Dream-Den, bringing Syr Konrad to the battlefield.
Repeat Milling until you mill the Titan, dealing damage with Syr Konrad.
